node.name: buy sell
node.chars: The buy / sell pair separates by hue only in normal vision and tritanopia (CIE76 ΔE dark 120.0 / deuteranopia 8.3 / protanopia 41.2 / tritanopia 127.7); that is why the side rides on segment order, ▲ / ▼ and the sign (§8), never on the hue.
